import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # Convert to 0-based index
X_test = test[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test["Id"].values

# Split for validation (non-stratified due to rare classes)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

# LightGBM parameters (optimized for accuracy and speed)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "seed": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validate
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_preds = np.argmax(y_val_pred, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
test_preds = np.argmax(y_test_pred, axis=1) + 1  # Convert back to 1-based

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
